title: POD Attestation Predicate Schema v0.1
description: Predicate schema for POD (Proof Of Data) in-toto v1 Statements wrapped in a DSSE envelope. Comprises 32 fields across 7 groups (identity, ownership, provenance, integrity, classification, handling, lifecycle) with 7 mandatory root-level requirements.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the POD attestation predicate schema.

identity.description: Group 1: Canonical object identity and storage metadata.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this attestation record.

locator.description: MANDATORY (1/7): Canonical URI locating the data object (e.g., file:///share/hr/comp.xlsx, postgres://db:5432/prod/public/customers).

object_type.description: Structural category of the attested data object.

environment.description: Deployment environment where the object resides.

ownership.description: Group 2: Accountable ownership and governance attribution.

owner.description: MANDATORY (2/7): Accountable owner identifier (principal URI, email, or team identifier).

steward.description: Data steward responsible for day-to-day classification review.

org_unit.description: Organizational unit or department owning the asset.

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory or geographic residency jurisdiction (e.g., US, EU, GLOBAL).

provenance.description: Group 3: Discovery origin, scanner identity, and OpenLineage upstream links.

attested_by.description: MANDATORY (3/7): Identifier of the attestation engine instance that produced the verdict.

source_system.description: Discovery mechanism or catalog source (e.g., openmetadata, tika-fileshare-crawler).

scanner_version.description: Version string of the discovery and classification pipeline.

discovered_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the object was scanned.

derived_from.description: Upstream object locators recorded via OpenLineage events.

integrity.description: Group 4: Cryptographic content and schema fingerprints.

content_sha256.description: MANDATORY (4/7): Lowercase hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the object content (must match in-toto subject digest).

schema_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of canonical DDL/column schema for structured tables.

size_bytes.description: Byte size of the file or table sample at attestation time.

row_count.description: Row count at attestation time for structured tables or spreadsheets.

fingerprint_method.description: Deterministic method used to compute content_sha256.

classification.description: Group 5: Authoritative sensitivity tier and detected entity category counts (never raw values).

tier.description: MANDATORY (5/7): Data classification tier ordered from lowest to highest sensitivity.

sensitive_categories.description: Detected sensitive entity types and counts (NEVER raw sensitive values).

category.description: Entity type identifier (e.g., US_SSN, EMAIL_ADDRESS, CREDIT_CARD, MEDICAL_LICENSE, API_KEY).

max_confidence.description: Highest confidence score observed for this category.

column_or_field.description: Column or metadata field name where detected (for tabular objects), never cell content.

handling.description: Group 6: Enforcement rules consumed by the Snapshot Publisher and Prevalidator.

policy.description: MANDATORY (6/7): Core enforcement policy tuple for AI gateways and consumers.

ai_eligibility.description: Whether the object may be forwarded to AI models ('allow'), stripped from prompts ('strip'), or causes request refusal ('deny').

minimum_clearance.description: Minimum clearance level required of the caller to reference this object.

egress_class.description: Maximum allowed egress destination class for AI requests touching this object.

allow_rag_indexing.description: Whether downstream vector stores are permitted to embed and index this object.

allow_model_training.description: Whether this object may be used for fine-tuning or training (always false unless explicitly enabled on Public/Internal).

redaction_categories.description: Categories that must be redacted if fallback content inspection runs.

lifecycle.description: Group 7: Record validity window, lifecycle state, and dual-approval audit trail.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the signed attestation record.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this record version was issued.

expires_at.description: MANDATORY (7/7): ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this record expires (bounded by tier TTL: Restricted <= 30d, Confidential <= 90d, Internal <= 180d, Public <= 365d).

ttl_days.description: Configured time-to-live in days for this record.

previous_record_id.description: ID of the prior record superseded by renewal or tier change.

revocation_reason.description: Reason code or note if revoked.

tier_lower_approvals.description: Dual-approval records required whenever a record's tier is lowered from a higher sensitivity tier.
